injuries.detail: Williamson is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to a left thigh contusion.
Murphy (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
